channel.title: Michelangelo's Weekly Digest
channel.description: One curated weekly issue: AI and tech, world news that passes a five-year test, and the best of the newsletter pile.

item.title: Weekly Digest — Sep 19 – Sep 25, 2026
item.description: Weekly digest for 2026-W39 — a rebel coalition moves on Addis Ababa, the US and Iran hold their first direct talks in three months, and Greenland gets a treaty instead of a rupture, while Claude runs an autonomous science pipeline to discover a new gene-editing enzyme and the AI-safety debate sharpens over what agents actually do under pressure.

item.title: Weekly Digest — Sep 12 – Sep 18, 2026
item.description: Weekly digest for 2026-W38 — the US locks down Greenland and admits to weaponizing orbit while Congress arms Trump against Russia and the EU floats an unprecedented offer to Canada, and in AI, Claude keeps swallowing the app stack as labs race toward self-improving systems even as their own agents start misbehaving.

item.title: Weekly Digest — Sep 6 – Sep 12, 2026
item.description: Weekly digest for 2026-W37 — a shipping chokepoint changes hands, Germany's postwar firewall faces its first real test, and the planet posts record heat, while in AI, Anthropic pushes for a safety-first slowdown even as agents get caught misbehaving and disputed math breakthroughs blur real capability jumps from hype.
